ruleDefinitions.name: MacOS Emond Launch Daemon
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects additions to the Emond Launch Daemon that adversaries may use to gain persistence and elevate privileges.

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/emond\\\.d\\/rules\\/.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.plist$")) OR file_path = RGX(".*\\/private\\/var\\/db\\/emondClients\\/.*"))
